message.content: {"findings":[{"cwe":"CWE-22","class":"Expand","method":"extractFile","explanation":"In extractFile, the attacker-controlled zip entry name (from ZipEntry.getName()) is resolved into a File via FileUtils.resolveFile and then written with FileOutputStream. The only containment check is f.getAbsolutePath().startsWith(dir.getAbsolutePath()), which is inadequate because a path such as a destination child containing ../ escapes the destination directory after OS path resolution while its absolute-path string still starts with the destination prefix."}]}
